Our Story

Born for Beautiful Flame

At Shobha Candles & Gifting, we believe that a beautiful flame can turn an ordinary moment into a memorable one. Our handcrafted candles are created with care, attention to detail and a passion for thoughtful gifting.

From corporate gifting and wedding favors to special celebrations and bulk requirements, we create candle experiences designed to leave a lasting impression.
